chunks: And Muḥammad ibn Qays narrated from Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام:

Regarding a man who married a slave-girl on the basis that she was free, then another man came and established proof that she was his slave-girl, he said: "He takes her, and he takes the value of her child."
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if a man marries a woman thinking she is free, but she is later proven to be someone else's slave?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a marriage contracted under the assumption that the woman was free, when it is later proven that she was another man's slave. The Imam عليه السلام rules that the rightful owner reclaims her and is also entitled to the value of her child, indicating the legal consequences of ownership and mistaken marital contracting.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4446 - Muhammad ibn Qays narrated from Abu Ja'far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as)

regarding a man who married a woman under the assumption that she was free, but then another man came forward and presented evidence proving that she was his slave, what is the ruling?
Imam (as) said: "He (the rightful owner) takes her back and also takes the value of her child."
